feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote chain closely: Penny's preview inspection, waiting-glass access, false price-collar description, and dishonest family valuation were all available beforehand. Opening the bottle and transferring poison are confessed acts rather than newly introduced decisive evidence. Her explanation that payment could not erase the betrayed trust resolves the apparent weakening of motive when the top-up was disclosed. The final line about being unable to manage relatives' responses fits her earlier desire to control the family calculation. It is earned and emotionally satisfactory, although the confession neatly narrates every deduction in order and could sound more shaken. Chip and Barb's responses credibly distinguish their admitted misconduct and provide a small consequence for each without reopening the solution.
